### Prerequisites:
- Prepare the matching AI model and enable the corresponding AI function

### Operation steps:
1. Download this configuration file template Click to download the configuration file compressed package [config.zip](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b915d4a0ca0decba94c788d1520bffb5 "[config.zip") Local decompression
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=439939d4aeed81dabab0f3edc233bfa4)
1. Open the text editing tool and fill in the speed threshold on the right. For the specific meaning of the fields, refer to the parameter notes below:
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=ecd1a66cbc303ab69d4c5db390267bb6)
> fFD_DsmLowVel; DSM alarm speed threshold (low), unit: km/h, default: 30
fFD_DsmHighVel; DSM alarm speed threshold (high), unit: km/h, default: 50

 >fFD_HmwVel; Headway Monitoring Warning (HMW) speed threshold, unit: km/h, 30.00
fFD_FcwVel; Forward Collision Warning (FCW) speed threshold, unit: km/h, 30.00
fFD_LdwVel; Lane Departure Warning (LDW) speed threshold, unit: km/h, 55.00
fFD_PcwVel; Pedestrian Collision Warning (PCW) speed threshold, unit: km/h, 50.00

 >fFD_BsdFirstLowVel; BSD Level 1 alarm speed threshold (low), unit: km/h, default: 5.00
fFD_BsdSecondLowVel; BSD Level 2 alarm speed threshold (low), unit: km/h, default: 5.00
fFD_BsdThirdLowVel; BSD Level 3 alarm speed threshold (low), unit: km/h, default: 5.00
fFD_BsdFirstHighVel; BSD Level 1 alarm speed threshold (high), unit: km/h, default: 0
fFD_BsdSecondHighVel; BSD Level 2 alarm speed threshold (high), unit: km/h, default: 0
fFD_BsdThirdHighVel; BSD Level 3 alarm speed threshold (high), unit: km/h, default: 0
The BSD speed threshold rules are as follows:
fFD_BsdFirstLowVel (Low) default value: 5
fFD_BsdFirstHighVel (High) default value: 0
If fFD_BsdFirstHighVel (High) ≤ fFD_BsdFirstLowVel (Low) (e.g., 0 ≤ 5), the low-speed value is used.
If fFD_BsdFirstHighVel (High) > fFD_BsdFirstLowVel (Low) (e.g., fFD_BsdFirstHighVel is 30 and fFD_BsdFirstLowVel is 5), the high-to-low speed range is used (i.e., the 30–5 km/h range); this rule applies to Levels 1, 2, and 3.

1. Unlock the device and remove the hard disk or SD card storage, use a hard disk reader or SD card reader to insert it into the computer, and open the root directory of the first storage partition
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=1af67e05be7087b5900c819dcaf652b3)
1. Copy the config file you just edited and saved to this directory, disconnect the device, insert the device and lock it
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5a7c4cedfdb1ba9476c4a63eda7b989b)
1. When the device is powered on, it will automatically import the configuration and restart. The configuration will take effect after the restart
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=f29b6a7205685638632647c31d7ec5e4)
